lines.say: acts like GnRH: LH and FSH surge at first, then it stops responding with continued use
testosterone surges briefly, then falls to castration levels in 91% to 98% by day 29
halts early puberty from age 2; LH suppressed in over 93% of 44 children (one trial)
treats endometriosis, an approved use in the UK but not the US
checked, since long-term use raises the risk of diabetes
heart rhythm checked if at risk; FDA calls the added heart attack and stroke risk low
early surge can flare prostate cancer, with urinary blockage or spinal cord compression
bone thinning with long-term use, which may raise fracture risk
hot flashes in 59% to 73% of men
mood changes, depression and seizures; raised skull pressure in children

ask: How will we watch my blood sugar, lipids, heart rhythm and bone health while I take it?
